title: Focus timer with work and break cycles
when: The user wants a focus timer that alternates work sessions with short and long breaks, with start, pause, skip and a sound at the end.
prompt:
Goal: A timer that stays accurate in background tabs, moves through phases on its own and announces only what matters.
Steps:
1. Settings: work 25, short 5, long 15 minutes, long break every 4 sessions; labeled number inputs saved in localStorage guarded.
2. On start store endAt = Date.now() + remaining; each tick computes endAt minus now, so throttled tabs stay right.
3. logic.mjs: nextPhase(phase, doneCount, settings), remaining(endAt, now), formatMMSS(ms) rounding up.
4. Tick every 250 ms; update the mm:ss display and document.title; aria-live announces phase changes, not every second.
5. At zero play a beep with Web Audio (AudioContext made on the first Start click) and switch phase; Pause, Resume, Skip, Reset buttons.
6. Progress ring as SVG stroke-dashoffset with role="img" and a label; count sessions done today.
7. test.mjs: long break on the 4th, formatMMSS at 0, 59,999 ms and 25 minutes.
Quality bar:
- Pausing and resuming loses no time.
- Digits use tabular-nums.
- Current phase is named in text.
Pitfalls:
- Counting setInterval ticks as seconds.
- Announcing every second to screen readers.
- Creating audio before a user gesture.
Verify:
- [ ] Time is derived from timestamps.
- [ ] Phases cycle correctly.
- [ ] Inputs labeled.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js (ticks, audio, UI), logic.mjs (phases and formatting), test.mjs.

examples.input: timer de estudo 25 min com pausas
examples.output: big 25:00, Start/Pause/Skip, ring progress, beep at end, long break after 4
